title: Model 2 C3: higher windage on leave-one-year-out development folds
scope: Nested (honest) leave-one-year-out development folds comparing a retrained recipe with windage 0.04 against the earlier windage 0.005 recipe and against persistence.
summary: On the 2021 and 2023 folds the higher-windage recipe improved IoU by +0.030 and +0.013 over the windage 0.005 recipe and by +0.091 and +0.093 over persistence. These are development folds. In the later disclosed second look on June to September 2026 (70 pairs), the C3 versus C difference was +0.006 with an interval spanning zero.

metrics.name: IoU gain over windage 0.005 recipe, 2021 fold
IoU gain over windage 0.005 recipe, 2023 fold

limitations: Development folds only; not a confirmation and not a live forecast result.
The later second look found no significant gain of C3 over C (+0.006, interval spanning zero) on an exposed cohort.
In the separate sub-kilometre study the 3% windage coefficient did not hold up forward in time.
Per-fold sample sizes and intervals are not retained in the public summary.
